title: Spatio-Temporal Multi-Order Interaction for Video Recognition
abstract: arXiv:2611.05633v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Many temporal approaches for video recognition rely on explicit cross-channel aggregation projections, which have quadratic complexity in the number of channels, introducing significant computational overhead. In addition, the spatio-temporal representation used for video recognition is biased either toward local order interactions (for CNNs) or toward global order interactions (for transformers). Starting from the multi-order spatial representation of MogaNet, our method introduces two complementary contributions to tackle these problems. First, for the temporal modelling, we introduce parallel multi-order processing with depthwise-only convolutions and implicit gating-based aggregation, which is linear in the number of channels, inducing a considerable computational reduction. translated_title: 面向视频识别的时空多阶交互
translated_abstract: 许多用于视频识别的时间建模方法依赖于显式的跨通道聚合投影，其复杂度随通道数呈二次方增长，带来了显著的计算开销。此外，用于视频识别的时空表示要么偏向局部阶交互（如CNN），要么偏向全局阶交互（如Transformer）。基于MogaNet的多阶空间表示，我们的方法引入了两个互补的贡献来解决这些问题。首先，在时间建模方面，我们引入了仅使用逐深度卷积的并行多阶处理以及基于隐式门控的聚合方式，其复杂度随通道数呈线性增长，从而大幅降低了计算量。其次，我们提出了空间维度与时间维度之间的双重交互机制，能够在不增加计算成本的情况下获得更好的时空表示。
tldr: 该论文提出基于逐深度卷积的线性复杂度多阶时间建模与时空双重交互机制，以更低的计算开销实现更优的视频时空表示。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes linear-complexity multi-order temporal modeling with depthwise-only convolutions and implicit gating, along with a dual spatio-temporal interaction mechanism, achieving better video representations at lower computational cost.
